items.briefing:
A case from Spain highlights a growing concern for all organisations: an AI agent was able to access and modify personal data within a system, a reminder that AI tools need the same access controls as human users. Separately, an Australian bank has moved to block staff from sending confidential data to public AI tools like ChatGPT — a smart safeguard as AI use in workplaces grows rapidly across all sectors, including registered training organisations handling student records.

**Practical tip:** Check whether your workplace has a clear policy on what information staff are allowed to enter into public AI tools — if not, raise it with your manager.

featured.title: AI Agent Breaches Spanish Organization, Modifies Personal Data
featured.summary: AI-driven cyberattacks used to be exotic. Soon, it'll be odd if threat actors aren't using agents to do all of their bidding.
